title: Mopeka Propane Tank Status Mix
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mopeka:tank
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(tank_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Mopeka propane tank feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `tank_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your Mopeka propane tank feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
